title: Delete the gate's -leave-to-ci budget once reconcile's suite is affordable
description:
r1f's per-package budget leaves internal/reconcile's full suite to CI on purpose: it measured 41m28s and 42m22s at the gate's own -parallel 12 on this host, against a short half of 1m33s, and most ticks reach reconcile through one import or another. The price, stated in the declaration: a dz1-shaped break in internal/reconcile ITSELF rides to the close-out's CI exactly as dz1 did, while every importer's suite (cli, factory, herdr, statusmodel, runlife) runs per tick. When this epic's [A1] halves the full suite and x73 lands, delete the name from .tick/runners.toml's go-touched command and the gate pays — a one-line change that deserves its own tick so the number is re-measured and re-justified rather than assumed.
evidence: the measurements and the reasoning: .tick/runners.toml, the go-touched entry's BOUND paragraph; the budget flag: internal/gatescope/gatescope.go (leaveToCI, validateLeaveToCI)

ticfac run epic-t8u filed this backlog tick from the finding f972591e04f44b4ed14cd069ad15593fdbc659bfd278c088d7567d551c3050fa (reported by run-epic-t8u/tick-r1f/attempt-13) rather than absorb it into the running epic: it is not absorbed: only a finding the final reviewer names blocking, or a high-severity one whose reporter names the done item it breaks while the work is under way, enters the running epic. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/epic-t8u/absorptions/f972591e04f44b4ed14cd069ad15593fdbc659bfd278c088d7567d551c3050fa.json on the run branch.
